subject: a stellar tide with translucent curved sheets
pose: sheets curling upward from the bottom
art_direction: 深青玻璃般的星潮从底端翻成几道圆弧，暖白光藏在边缘。
visible_description: 深青玻璃般的星潮从底端翻成几道圆弧，暖白光藏在边缘。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Imagine a stellar tide as three translucent teal sheets curling upward from the lower edge. Their rims hold narrow warm-white highlights, while their interiors reveal smoky glass depth. Avoid literal flames or bursting energy; the forms move like slow sculptural waves. Use a dark blue field and only a few tiny light points near the central folds. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
